title: Graduate Civil Engineer / Site Engineer
abstract: Launch your engineering career with great pay, mentoring, regional projects and genuine long-term opportunities.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?

Have you completed a qualification in engineering?
Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?

content_text:
Graduate Civil Engineer / Junior Project Engineer
Are you ready to kickstart your civil engineering career in a dynamic, family-owned company? Aitken Civil Engineering is a trusted name in the earthworks and road construction industry, delivering quality civil projects across Sydney and Regional NSW.
Join our passionate team and work on major civil projects that will shape your career and the communities we serve.
About Us:
We are a family-owned and operated civil construction company specialising in earthworks, road construction and related services. With a strong focus on safety, quality and productivity, we take pride in our collaborative approach and long-term relationships with both clients and employees.
We are committed to developing our people and supporting long-term careers in civil construction.
What You’ll Do:
As a Graduate Civil Engineer, you will work closely with experienced Project Managers and Engineers who will mentor and support your development.
With training and guidance, your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with project planning, organisation, and programming
- Supporting procurement of materials and services
- Conducting safety inspections and maintaining compliance
- Communicating with clients and stakeholders
- Performing quality assurance checks and site inspections
- Maintaining and auditing internal management systems
- Reviewing drawings and issuing RFIs
- Assisting with site survey and set out
- Compiling site costings and assisting with budgets
What We’re Looking For:
We value attitude, reliability and a genuine desire to learn. Our ideal candidate will have:
- A tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering (or related field)
- Graduate to 1 – 2 years’ experience (graduates encouraged to apply)
- MUST be willing to work away in Regional NSW
- Class C driver’s licence
- White Card (or willingness to obtain)
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- A proactive and positive mindset
Why Join Aitken Civil Engineering?
We invest in our people and support long-term career growth. We offer:
- Structured on-the-job training and mentoring
- Exposure to major civil construction projects
- Competitive salary, reviewed as you progress
- Accommodation when working away
- Living Away from Home Allowance (LAFHA)
- Company vehicle with fuel costs covered
- Supportive, family-oriented workplace
Career Development:
At Aitken Civil, our graduates are developed into Project Engineers and future leaders within the business. You will be given increasing responsibility as your skills and confidence grow.
Work Schedule:
Projects are in Regional NSW, with occasional work in the Sydney region. Depending on location, rosters may include:
- 5 days on / 2 days off
- 10 days on / 4 days off
- Work Monday to Friday regionally, travel back to Sydney for weekends in provided vehicle
- Saturday work require sporadically depending on project timelines
Please be prepared to work regionally each week travelling to and from Sydney.
Our Culture:
We believe in creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged and valued. Our team is built on integrity, teamwork and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.
Learn more about us at:
www.aitkencivil.com.au
